notes: The programme page gives no tuition figure for this programme. The only EUR amount found (EUR 18,150.00) is in a Medicine and Surgery – Bolzano page, for a different programme. Application deadlines differ by programme: the Business and Finance page names only "September 2026" as next intake and says applications for 2026/2027 are closed, with the next period opening in Fall 2026 for 2027/2028 — no dated deadline for this programme. The dated deadlines found (4 November 2026 / 17 February 2027) belong to the Economics and Management programme timeline page, not to Business and Finance, so no intake fact is given. The programme page directs to the university's own online application portal ("Access the online application portal"), so the channel is recorded as it-university-direct; no page for this programme mentions Universitaly.
